global.title: Commercial Space Federation (CSF) Welcomes Two New Members
global.summary: September 21, 2026— Washington, D.C. —The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome ORBITInsure and Renaissance Strategic Advisors (RSA) as its newest members. ORBITInsure joins CSF as a Space Supply Chain member, while RSA joins CSF as an Associate Member and as a member of both the Space Supply Chain Council and State and Local Council. global.title: Pentagon plans phased Golden Dome buildout through 2035
global.summary: WASHINGTON — Gen. Michael Guetlein, head of the Golden Dome missile defense program, said the Pentagon is taking a two-stage approach, planning to stitch together existing military systems for an initial missile shield in 2028 before transitioning to a more affordable architecture designed specifically for homeland defense by 2035.
